name: de.blinkt.openvpn.core.OpenVPNService
description: Manojmiyani99's OpenVPN library, also included in Skyjie6's ITVPN SDK, starts this Android VPN service when either SDK connects; it creates the tunnel, keeps it running in the foreground, and provides a disconnect action.
disableEffect: Blocking this Service prevents the VPN tunnel from connecting and stops any tunnel it currently runs.
